blocks.text: Mass spectrometry se tajurbe (experiment) ke zariye isotopes ki relative abundance (nisbati miqdar) maloom ki ja sakti hai. Relative abundance ka matlab hai ke qudrat mein paye jane wale isotopes ke mixture mein kisi khaas isotope ka kitna hissa hai. Maslan Cl-35 aur Cl-37 ki relative abundance bil-tarteeb 75% aur 25% hai. Mass spectrum mein peaks ki unchai har isotope ka hissa dikhati hai. Maslan neeche ke graph mein peaks boron ke isotopes ki relative abundance dikhati hain: boron-10 ki 19.9% aur boron-11 ki 80.1%.

blocks.alt: Boron ka mass spectrum: % abundance aur m/e, m/e 10 par chhota peela daanda 19.9 aur m/e 11 par lamba hara daanda 80.1.
blocks.caption: Boron ka mass spectrum (29.6.1 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Kisi element ka mass relative atomic mass (Aᵣ) ki shakal mein diya jata hai, jo us ke isotopes ka ausat (average) mass hai. Yeh isotopes ki relative abundance aur un ke masses se nikala jata hai. Isotope ki relative abundance ya to sawal mein di jati hai ya mass spectrum se parhi jati hai.

blocks.text_alt: Relative Atomic Mass (Aᵣ) = Σ (isotopic mass × isotopic abundance) / 100

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Har isotope ke mass ko us ke percentage se zarab (multiply) karein, sab ko jama karein aur 100 se taqseem (divide) karein. Jo isotope zyada hai, jawab us ke mass ke qareeb aata hai.

blocks.title: Misal 29.2
blocks.problem: Oxygen ka relative atomic mass, Aᵣ, do decimal tak nikalein.

blocks.title: Misal 29.3
blocks.problem: Boron ke mass spectrum se us ka relative atomic mass do decimal tak nikalein.

blocks.title: Aik aur misal
blocks.text: Chlorine (³⁵Cl 75%, ³⁷Cl 25%): Aᵣ = [(75 × 35) + (25 × 37)] / 100 = 35.5. Isi liye chlorine ka atomic mass 35.5 likha jata hai.
